# eos-aero

> llms.txt for the eos-aero repository (embeddedos-org/eos-aero).
> Status: the aerospace vertical of EmbeddedOS — a web
> application plus the aeros_ai package, with a silicon-target
> roster maintained against functional-safety requirements.

eos-aero applies the EmbeddedOS platform to aerospace use:
safety-fragment-aware silicon selection (redundancy, lockstep,
radiation posture) and the sector's functional-safety record.

- [Silicon targets — knowledge-base seed](docs/silicon-targets.md)
